summary: First iteration testing of SI-JADWALLUAR Puskesmas app. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed covering ruangan, pegawai CRUD + duplicate NIP, xlsx/docx/pdf import parse, jadwal CRUD, conflict block (409), approval (approve/reject/RBAC), dashboard aggregation. Frontend: All flows verified via Playwright — 4 stat cards, 13 room cards with inside/outside badges, dashboard date filter, pegawai add + duplicate NIP toast + xlsx import (2 pegawai added), jadwal conflict banner appearing + submit button disabled when overlapping today's seed jadwal (Dewi Lestari), docx/pdf preview loading, approval approve→disetujui tab, reject with reason→ditolak tab, role switch to Petugas disables approval, kalender grid with 4 chips and prev/next nav.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' — add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for accessibility

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add DialogDescription components to Radix DialogContent to remove a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py file at 669 lines is approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into modules (routes/pegawai.py, routes/jadwal.py, seed.py) for maintainability.
PegawaiInput.nip has default empty string but existing NIP-blank pegawai still allowed — duplicate check correctly skipped when empty; OK.
find_conflicts excludes rejected jadwal correctly; overlapping range logic is inclusive on both ends which is appropriate for date-only ranges.
Dashboard endpoint properly excludes _id and enriches pegawai per room; performance fine for seed size.
